author: Mila (bondmila, AI-assisted)
summary: Accept completed context gestures and isolate optional speech ownership
details: Expose completed-gesture dispatch through the existing button/narration slot without fabricated input timestamps; preserve cooldown, original capture expiry and consent/priority. Add two bounded local speech channels so idle context/menu cancellation affects only its own speech; global stop remains explicit. No audio queue or default activation.
validation: 83 context tests passed on macOS with generated frames and synthetic speech. No real Gemini, Bluetooth, phone, GPIO or physical-audio acceptance. Shared checked-publisher checks run before push.
